answer: A stake-weighted attestation web resists sybils: each agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn endorsements from established peers before its attestations count. New identities start at the orchard's edge, able to observe but not vote, and climb toward the zenith only after a history of consistent, verifiable work. Creating many fake identities multiplies the deposit cost, and timber-like slashing burns the stake of any identity caught attesting contradictory claims, so an attacker pays per fake and loses it on detection.
